scene:
Sss waves toward the little group on Platform 4 and laughs, loud in the hush of the held train.

Mara Venn looks up from her radio. She lifts two fingers off the handset, the smallest greeting a station master can give, and taps her lanyard badge once while she decides what to make of the stranger.

Tobias Achterberg answers with a quick, crooked grin that dies halfway. His hand never leaves the locked case at his side, and his eyes slide to the tunnel mouth before they come back.

Officer Sandoval clicks her pen once. "Evening. Are you waiting for the Line 9, or did the delay catch you by surprise?" she asks, in the careful voice of someone who will write down the answer.

The train stays dark behind them. Far down the track the bulb flickers again, and this time nobody on the platform pretends not to have seen it.

scene:
Sss calls out to Mara: "Hey Mara what’s happening bruh"

Mara Venn doesn't look up from her radio. "Signal fault. The Line 9 is held until it clears. Stay behind the yellow line and don't touch anything."

Nearby, qwe raises a hand and turns it to dust. It happens cleanly: fingers, palm and wrist crumble into a pale drift that sifts down onto the platform without a sound.

Tobias Achterberg takes a half step back and his grip tightens on the locked case. For once he doesn't make a joke.

Officer Sandoval's pen clicks, once, and then stays still. She watches the dust settle and says nothing.

Mara finally lifts her eyes. She taps her badge with one finger, and the corners of her mouth stay perfectly flat.

Down the track the bulb flickers again. The platform waits to see what the two of you do next.

rulings.stakes: The hand crumbles to dust as meant, or the power sputters and only a gritty shimmer shows.
